name: Default
shortDescription: Subtitle manager for Sonarr and Radarr that searches and downloads subtitles for your series and movies based on language preferences.

alerts.message: The web UI has no login until you enable authentication under Settings > General > Security. Bazarr also needs the API keys of Sonarr and Radarr and access to the same media files they manage, mounted at /movies and /tv or matched with path mappings.
